! colspan="{{{colspan|1}}}" style="background:{{{background|#F2F5FD}}}; border:1px solid {{{2|#B4C5E3}}}; width:{{{3|auto}}}" | {{{1}}}<noinclude>

==Notes==
This template is one in a series of modular source templates meant to be used to generate box-style navigation templates. It is meant to be [[m:Help:substitution|substituted]] and will not work properly if <code>subst:</code> is not present in the template call.

==Usage instructions==
<pre>{{Nav box heading|text|border|width}}</pre>
Use <code>|-</code> beforehand to start a heading box on a new row, just like in a table.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|text}}}} The text content of the box.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para||{{Var|border}}}} The color of the 1px box border, default <code style="padding:0 5px 0 5px; border:1px solid #B4C5E3">#B4C5E3</code>. Enter <code>none</code> or <code>transparent</code> for no border at all.</li>
#{{Para||{{Var|width}}}} The box width, default automatic.
#{{Para|colspan}} The column span of the box, default <code>1</code>.
#{{Para|background}} The heading background color, default <code style="color:black; padding:0 5px 0 5px; background:#F2F5FD">#F2F5FD</code> in light theme. Enter <code>none</code> or <code>transparent</code> for the box to blend in with the container nav box.

==Box-style navigation source templates==
*{{Tl|Nav box start}}
*{{Tl|Nav box heading}}
*{{Tl|Nav box}}
*{{Tl|Nav box end}}

==Example==
===Code===
<pre>
{{Nav box start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav box heading|The 1st box is the deepest}}
{{Nav box heading|2 Boxy 2 Blurious}}
|-
{{Nav box|3 blind boxes}}
{{Nav box|Box box BOX bOX}}
{{Nav box end}}
</pre>

===Result===
{{Nav box start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav box heading|The 1st box is the deepest}}
{{Nav box heading|2 Boxy 2 Blurious}}
|-
{{Nav box|3 blind boxes}}
{{Nav box|Box box BOX bOX}}
{{Nav box end}}
